title: Implement a queue using two stacks in Rust
description: Implement Queue<T> with amortized O(1) enqueue/dequeue using two Vec<T> (inbox/outbox). Transfer inbox to outbox when outbox is empty.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Queue<T> in src/lib.rs using two Vec<T> fields `inbox` and `outbox`:
- new: return Queue with empty inbox/outbox
- enqueue: push val to inbox
- dequeue: if outbox is empty, drain inbox into outbox (pop from inbox, push to outbox); then pop from outbox
- peek: if outbox non-empty return outbox.last(); else return inbox.first()
- is_empty: inbox.is_empty() && outbox.is_empty()
- len: inbox.len() + outbox.len()
All 3 cargo test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
